abstentions.topic: income lines entering the unified base
abstentions.reason: L136-3 I 1° defines the base as "sur le montant, hors plus-values et moins-values de long terme, des produits tirés de ces mêmes activités, diminué du montant des charges que l'acquisition de ces produits nécessitent"; whether compulsory social contributions, Madelin contributions or the spouse's contributions are such 'charges' is not stated; the former explicit add-back of contributions (old CSG base) has no counterpart in the text. The proposal keeps the library's existing line as a flagged PLACEHOLDER; all 'after' amounts are conditional on it.

abstentions.topic: épargne salariale deductions and revenus de remplacement in the base
abstentions.reason: "En sont toutefois déduites les sommes mentionnées aux articles L. 3312-4, L. 3324-5 et L. 3332-27 du code du travail" and the inclusion of revenus de remplacement: no input exists in the library; not transposed.

D621-2: reduction applies only when the base is "inférieur à trois fois la valeur annuelle du plafond"; above, the base rate of D621-1 applies, which is not in the bounded set. The proposal's 8,5 % above 300 % is the mechanical extension of the last tranche, not a transposed value.

The consolidated records give in-force dates only (law articles 2023-12-28; decree articles 2024-07-07). The schedule of application to the contributions of a given year (LFSS 2024 art. 18 transitional provisions) is not in the corpus. The proposal gates on 07/07/2024; evaluating the reform at 2024-12-01 follows from that gate alone and is flagged NEEDS_REVIEW.
No 2025 value of the plafond de la sécurité sociale is in the corpus or the library; the 2025-06-01 evaluations use the library's 2024 value (3 864 €/mois).
The text gives formulas without a rounding rule; the library rounds the rate to 2 decimals (7,0333 -> 7,03). Kept, not asserted.
The floor's cap refers to L633-1 (outside the set); D632-1 is unchanged; the pre-existing 2024 floor mismatch (5 243 vs 5 332) is not resolved here.
CSG 6,8 % / 2,9 %, RCI 7 % / 8 %, invalidité-décès 1,3 %, IJ 0,5 %, AF thresholds, CFP 0,25 % / 0,29 %, maladie 6,5 % above 5 PSS: unchanged in the proposal and not asserted.

abstentions.topic: AE articles D613-4 / D613-6 (out of T1b scope)
abstentions.reason: S3 now carries the text of D613-4 LEGIARTI000049624068 (2024-07-01..2025-05-01: b) 23,2 %, e) 23,1 %, a) 12,3 %, c) 6 %, d) 21,2 %) and D613-6 LEGIARTI000049625264 (2024-07-01..2025-01-01, new splits). They concern auto-entrepreneur rules, not the indépendant rules of this task; recorded for a later task (sophon REASSESS_LAW_CHANGED on the T0/T1a links). Versions LEGIARTI000049624097 / LEGIARTI000049624125 / LEGIARTI000049625405 / LEGIARTI000049625445 still have no text.
